title: Ontario Math Circles ARML
text:
Ontario Math Circles' team sends 3 teams of 15 to The Pennsylvania State University site of the ARML Competition. The teams are decided via a Team Selection Test.


Historical Results[edit]

2026: Ontario Math Circles A1 got second place and had 5 members in the tiebreaker. Leo Wu got 3rd, Perry Dai got 10th, Ryan Li got 52nd, Chris Fu got 71st and Andrew Ma got 72nd. Ontario Math Circles A2 got 32nd and Lei He was 39th.

2025: Ontario Math Circles A1 got eighth place and had 7 members in the tiebreaker. Michael Sun got 15th, Leo Wu got 17th, Tiger Li got 32nd, Kaylyn Zhang got 42nd, Perry Dai got 48th, and Eric Jia got 63rd. Ontario Math Circles A2 got 26th and Prince Zhang got 62nd.
